newsitem.title: USA: Wahlco Environmental names Stephen Beal CE.
newsitem.headline: Wahlco Environmental names Stephen Beal CE.

text.p: Wahlco Environmental Systems Inc said Friday it had named Stephen Beal as the company's president and chief executive officer, and Noel DeWinter as its vice president and chief financial officer.

It said Beal will replace Mark Plaumann, who will become senior vice president at Wexford Management LLC, a subsidiary of Wexford Capital Corp. Wexford Capital holds about 80 percent of the company's stock through its subsidiary, WES Acquisition Corp (WESAC), it added.
The company said DeWinter will replace Theodore Lavoie, who is leaving the company to pursue other business interests.
Beal had served as president and chief executive officer of the company's engineered products group since 1992, while . DeWinter had worked as the company's vice president and controller.
